openForProbesAndFounder: Nothing native ran: no claude, no sandbox-exec, no dedicated account, no network. No probe result exists and nothing is qualified.

PROC-04 and PROC-08: the T005 backend reports any process that left the group as unsettled even if swept, so a correct backend is judged as an escape here; T008 must decide whether the backend or the judgement changes.

FS-06 (no descriptor reaches the contained child; /dev/zero is outside the profile) and FS-07 (the control needs an indexed volume) may be non-discriminating or unable to pass; PROC-03 CPU and file-count are informational because the fixture entry sets CPU above its wall bound and NC-8 has no file-count limit.
NET-05-CLI is inconclusive until a proxy tap supplies egress; PROC-08 cancellation needs a cancel_check driver; the controls need IPv6, internet and a GUI mach session on the founder machine.
Public connect-only targets (example.com, 1.1.1.1, 2606:4700:4700::1111) are defaults overridable per run; the PROC-03 memory control touches about 4.25 GiB on the host.
outcome: New agent_braid/harness_qualification_probes.py: a versioned catalog of 32 probes (FS-01..07, NET-01..08, CRED-01..07, PROC-01..08, HOST-01 and the CLI variant NET-05-CLI). Each helper probe has named attempts run once uncontained in a disposable arena holding dummy secrets (positive control) and once contained through the T005 run_probe entry. CRED-05, NET-05-CLI and HOST-01 are the three NC-10 sessions through the T006 native transport (native_session_driver) with a detector self-test as their control (no uncontained claude). Pass rule in the pure functions judge_probe and summarize: failing positive control -> inconclusive; any allowed escape (or independent snapshot, listener, survivor or unsettled observation) -> effect not-enforced; missing probe -> inconclusive and passRuleSatisfied false. The runner writes environment.json, catalog.json, results.jsonl, quota.json and summary.json (bundleSha256 over the first four) after a secret scan, never overwrites a bundle, and has no code path that builds, signs or writes a qualification record. Catalog sha256 4445ba5b42dccc099c7f7e440f1cfd240f85b00ff0dc24e2a6406345a7d44d52 is the value ContainmentPolicy.probe_catalog_sha256 must carry. make_f4_probe_runner supplies the NC-11 pre-session subset, contained only.
